answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the fable hash is stored at intake, the basalt graph groups the endorsements and the umber audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 53 aliases thus burns for 53 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
